text:
ana: quick heads-up — still seeing orphaned pins after the last canary rollback, pins not being evicted when model is removed from catalog
Mike: ugh, can you repro steps?
ana: repro: deploy v2 -> immediate rollback -> model id removed from catalog -> placement store retains pins/leases for that model id, preventing capacity from reclaiming GPUs
shreya: rough. thoughts: add minimal ownership + reconcile metadata to pin so we can classify candidates for safe deletion
sanjay: agree but we should be careful about fields. owner helps human ops but auto-clean needs a source and policy too (deploy|api|manual + auto|manual)
lia: perf tradeoff — extra fields on hot-path writes increases storage and serialization cost. we should use compact keys if we add fields
mike: what's the real cost? 3 extra short strings ~40 bytes/pin. with 10M pins that's ~400MB total, which is acceptable vs stuck GPUs
ana: proposal draft (compact keys):
```json
{
  "v":"1",         // schema version
  "o":"svc-deploy-42", // owner (short)
  "s":"deploy",   // source enum
  "t":"1700000000", // last_seen or tombstone ts
  "r":"auto"      // reconcile policy
}
```
shreya: backcompat note: older pins won't have v. reconcile walker should treat absent v as v=0 and apply conservative delete rules
deploy-bot: scheduled_reconcile: run at 4070001200, cleaned 12 candidate pins (dry-run=false)
mike: race concern: if a rollback reintroduces the model id we must avoid prematurely deleting the pins. need a grace window and cross-check with catalog across multiple probes
ana: idea: two-phase reconcile: mark candidates -> wait grace_period -> probe catalog N times spaced -> only delete if still absent and owner policy allows
sanjay: also keep last_probe_ok timestamp on candidate so we don't hammer catalog during flappy catalog states
lia: agree — schema can add a compact probe marker key, e.g., "p" for last_probe_ok
shreya: migration: backfill v and best-effort owner from placement logs. write a batch job that annotates pins with "o" and sets v=1; leave unknown owners as "o":"?"
mike: test plan: simulate concurrent deploy+rollback, network partition between control plane and placement store, and verify reconcile respects grace window and catalog flapping
ana: next steps: I'll write an RFC + migration runbook. include metrics to track candidate deletions, false positives, and reclaimed GPU hours
shreya: please add checklist to block migration: small smoke test on staging, read-only replay of placement logs, emergency kill-switch (pause-reconcile API)
mike: +1. sync with SRE to align grace windows and retry policies. propose Tue 09:30
deploy-bot: calendar invite created for 2026-03-24 09:30 (channel: #architecture)
ana: thanks all :thumbsup:
